# Line Item Totals

## Summary
The arithmetic every priced document repeats, over the base `AmountWithCurrency` shape: `lineTotal(item)` is quantity times unit price; `sumLineItems(items)` totals a list and reports the first currency code it meets; `orderTotals(items, taxRate)` adds tax on top; `outstandingBalance(items, payments)` is what is still owed, never below zero. `formatMoney` is re-exported from the CRM utils so a consumer imports one module.

These are plain functions over structural types (`MoneyLike`, `LineItemLike`, `PaymentLike`), so a quote, an invoice or an order can call them on its own line items without adopting a shared card.

## Usage
```ts
import {
  orderTotals,
  formatMoney,
} from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/commerce/line-item-totals';

let { total, code } = orderTotals(quote.lineItems, 8.25);
formatMoney(total, code); // "$12,400.00"
```

## Non-goals
Not a money type: storage is base `AmountWithCurrency`. No currency conversion: mixed-currency lines total in the first code seen, so a consumer that allows mixing converts first. No rounding policy beyond what `Intl.NumberFormat` applies at display.
